name: Daniel Avinoam
biography: As a security researcher at Deep Instinct, Daniel develops and researches new defense capabilities. After serving for several years in the advanced technological cyber unit under the Israeli Air Force, Daniel has experience in the defensive side of cyber warfare, including forensics, incident response, development, reverse engineering, and research.
